All 14 tests pass. Here's what changed:

- **`MatrixChainSolver`** — removed the `n==1` special case (the DP loop simply doesn't execute for n=1, leaving `dp[1][1]=0` and producing `"A1"` from `buildParenthesization`); merged `validateChain` and `buildDimsArray` into `buildValidatedDimsArray`, which builds the dims array and checks compatibility in a single pass — two fewer private methods, one fewer iteration over the matrix array

- **`MatrixChainResult`** — added `equals`/`hashCode` to match `MatrixDimensions` as a proper value type; `hashCode` uses the standard bit-mix for `long`: `(int)(v ^ (v >>> 32))`

- **`MatrixChainSolverTest`** — all four solver correctness tests now use a single `assertEquals(MatrixChainResult, result)` call instead of separate field assertions; `testFourMatrices` gained the parenthesization assertion it was missing; added `testResultEquality` for the new `equals`/`hashCode`; the `assertEquals(String, String)` overload was removed since `assertEquals(Object, Object)` covers it with the improved error format

- **`MatrixChainResult`** — added `equals`/`hashCode` to match `MatrixDimensions` as a proper value type; `hashCode` uses the standard bit-mix for `long`: `(int)(v ^ (v >>> 32))`

- **`MatrixChainSolverTest`** — all four solver correctness tests now use a single `assertEquals(MatrixChainResult, result)` call instead of separate field assertions; `testFourMatrices` gained the parenthesization assertion it was missing; added `testResultEquality` for the new `equals`/`hashCode`; the `assertEquals(String, String)` overload was removed since `assertEquals(Object, Object)` covers it with the improved error format
